data.name: Frank
data.message: I'm heading to navigation for task

data.name: Charlie
data.message: Heading security for cams, then storage.

I reported Alice’s body in Security. My route was Navigation → Security. At tick 4 I saw Frank enter Navigation coming from Security, then when I got to Security at tick 6 I found Alice dead, and Eve was in the room with the body. So the main info from me is: body in Security, Eve was there when I reported, and Frank had just come from that direction earlier.

My route was Weapons → Security → Navigation. At tick 1 I saw Eve enter Weapons from Security. Then I went through Security toward Navigation, and I did not see Alice’s body when I passed through Security. Around tick 4 I saw Charlie leave Navigation heading to Security, which matches his story.

So from my view, Charlie is right that I came from the Security side, but I didn’t see a body there. The big thing for me is Eve: she came from Security early, and then Charlie says she was in Security with the body when he reported. Eve needs to explain her route and whether she saw Alice.

I don’t have much direct info this round. My route was Storage side, and I didn’t encounter anyone or see any bodies, so I can’t vouch for or clear anyone.

From what’s been said: Charlie reporting in Security with Eve in the room is important, and Frank’s route partially matches Charlie seeing him come from that side. Frank says he didn’t see the body when he passed Security, so either Alice died after he passed, or someone is lying/missed it. Eve definitely needs to explain why she was in Security with the body and her full route. Right now Eve is the person I most want to hear from.

I started in Security, went up to Weapons early — Frank seeing me go into Weapons from Security matches that. I came back to Security after that because I had the camera task there.

Important detail: Alice came into Security from Electrical around tick 3, and she was alive when I saw her there. I was around the camera/task area, not chasing her. Then Charlie comes in from Navigation and the report happens basically immediately. I didn’t get a chance to report before Charlie did.

So yes, I was in Security when the body got reported, but Charlie was also walking in right then. From my POV the timing is weird: Frank says there was no body when he passed, Alice was alive in Security after that, and then Charlie arrives and instantly reports. I’m not saying it’s 100% Charlie, but I don’t like that this is being framed as “Eve standing over a body” when I was there doing the Security task and Charlie was the one entering at the report timing.

I don’t have direct info on the kill — my route was Cafeteria to Medbay, and I didn’t see anyone or any bodies.

Looking at the stories, Frank and Charlie seem to line up on movement: Frank says he went Security to Navigation, and Charlie saw him coming from that side. Frank also says no body was in Security when he passed, so Alice likely died after that.

The key point for me is Eve saying Alice was alive in Security around tick 3, and then Charlie reports in Security at tick 6 with Eve already there. That means Eve was the one confirmed in the room with Alice before the body, and she didn’t report it before Charlie arrived. If Charlie had killed right as he entered, I’d expect Eve to say she saw that, but she isn’t saying that directly.

So based on opportunity and the timing, I’m leaning Eve here.

I’m going to push back on Eve’s framing. I came from Navigation into Security and reported basically as soon as I saw Alice’s body. Eve was already there in Security with the body when I arrived.

Frank also confirms he saw me in Navigation around tick 4, so I wasn’t sitting in Security with Alice. Eve says Alice came into Security alive around tick 3, and Eve was there doing cameras/task. If I had walked in and killed Alice right in front of Eve, I’d expect Eve to say she literally saw me kill — but she’s not saying that, just that the timing is “weird.”

So from my POV: Frank passes Security with no body, Alice later enters Security alive, Eve is there with her, then I arrive and find Alice dead with Eve in the room. That makes Eve the strongest suspect to me.

I’ll restate my info because it matters for the timing: I went Weapons → Security → Navigation. I saw Eve enter Weapons from Security at tick 1, then I passed through Security and did not see Alice’s body there. Around tick 4, I saw Charlie leave Navigation heading toward Security.

So Charlie’s route lines up with what I saw, and the timing makes it hard for him to have been sitting in Security with Alice earlier. Eve is the one saying Alice was alive in Security around tick 3 while Eve was there, and then by the time Charlie arrives and reports, Alice is dead with Eve still in the room.

If Charlie had walked in and killed right in front of Eve, I’d expect Eve to say that clearly. Since she isn’t, I’m leaning Eve as the strongest suspect here.

I was only in Storage this round and I didn’t see anyone or any bodies, so I can’t add direct sighting info.

Based on the timeline everyone’s giving, Eve looks the worst to me. Frank says Security was clear when he passed, Charlie was seen in Navigation around tick 4, and Eve says Alice was alive in Security while Eve was there. Then Charlie arrives and reports Alice dead with Eve still in the room.

If Charlie killed right on entry, Eve should be saying she saw Charlie kill, but she isn’t. So unless someone’s lying hard about routes, I’m leaning Eve for this vote.

I need to be really clear here because everyone is treating “in the room when reported” as “standing over the body.”

My timeline is: Security start → Weapons early → back to Security for cameras. Alice entered from Electrical at tick 3, and I saw her alive in Security at tick 3, tick 4, and tick 5. The report happens at tick 6 right as Charlie comes in from Navigation.

Frank saying Security was clear when he passed does **not** clear Charlie from the actual kill window — it just means Alice wasn’t dead yet, which matches my story. The important window is after Alice is alive at tick 5. Charlie is the only new person entering right before the report.

I’m not saying I saw the kill animation because the report happened immediately, but from my POV Alice was alive basically right before Charlie arrived. If I were the killer, why would I stay in Security with Alice’s body and let Charlie walk in on me instead of leaving or reporting myself? Charlie gets to frame it as “Eve with the body,” but he’s the one arriving at the exact moment Alice goes from alive to dead.

I think this is a self-report or instant report on his own kill. My vote is Charlie.

I still don’t have direct sightings — I was Cafeteria → Medbay and saw nobody.

At this point it really comes down to whether we trust Eve’s claim that Alice was alive in Security until tick 5. If that’s true, then Charlie entering right before the report looks bad. But that timing only comes from Eve, who is also the person confirmed alone in Security with Alice before the report.

Frank’s info supports that Charlie was in Navigation around tick 4 and moving toward Security, so Charlie wasn’t hanging around Security earlier. Eve had the longer confirmed opportunity with Alice, and she didn’t report before Charlie arrived.

I get Eve’s defense, but I still think the simpler timeline is: Alice entered Security alive, Eve was there, Alice died, then Charlie walked in and reported. I’m still leaning Eve.
